Revelations in Fall#000.src: Attend the meeting in the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#001.src: Hello, everyone. Thank you for being here today.
Revelations in Fall#001.dst: 各位好。謝謝你們今天到場。
Revelations in Fall#001.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#002.src: It has been growing increasingly clear that there is very little we can do here to make a larger impact on Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#002.dst: 愈來愈明顯的是，待在這裡，我們能對 Fruma 造成的更大影響非常有限。
Revelations in Fall#002.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#003.src: We have been doing good for the people of Auburn! But our resources are limited, and our opportunities to take action are even more so.
Revelations in Fall#003.dst: 我們確實為 Auburn 的人民做了好事！但我們的資源有限，能採取行動的機會更是有限。
Revelations in Fall#003.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#004.src: Additionally, the risks of our operation grow by the day. I do not regret taking in {u} as a member, but it's no secret that we risk more scrutiny by having them here.
Revelations in Fall#004.dst: 此外，我們行動的風險與日俱增。我不後悔接納 {u} 成為成員，但有他們在這裡會招來更多注意，這不是秘密。
Revelations in Fall#004.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#005.src: Zeph and {u} learned yesterday that an Inquisitor is arriving in the area. We don't know what for exactly, but their presence further endangers our cause.
Revelations in Fall#005.dst: Zeph 和 {u} 昨天得知有一位審訊官要來這一帶。我們不清楚具體是為了什麼，但他的出現讓我們的事業更加危險。
Revelations in Fall#005.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#006.src: At the festival, I received word from a contact in the Roughworks. There's a group similar to ours there, run by an old friend of mine they're called the Steel Feather.
Revelations in Fall#006.dst: 在慶典上，我收到了 Roughworks 一位聯絡人的消息。那裡有一個跟我們類似的組織，由我的一位老朋友帶領——他們叫鋼羽。
Revelations in Fall#006.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#007.src: They have resources we don't, and are situated in a much more favorable position. If we're able to cross through to the Roughworks, they've agreed to host us and help plan our next moves.
Revelations in Fall#007.dst: 他們有我們沒有的資源，位置也有利得多。只要我們能越過去 Roughworks，他們同意收留我們，並協助規劃下一步。
Revelations in Fall#007.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#008.src: So, what are our next moves? I don't know what you expect us to do there that we're not already able to do here.
Revelations in Fall#008.dst: 所以，我們的下一步是什麼？我不知道你期待我們在那裡做什麼，是我們在這裡做不到的。
Revelations in Fall#008.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#009.src: I'm still workshopping ideas, but they involve the Crown Festival. If we move quickly, we'll be able to catch it in the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#009.dst: 我還在琢磨一些想法，不過都跟王室慶典有關。動作夠快的話，我們趕得上 Roughworks 那一場。
Revelations in Fall#009.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#010.src: Of course, traveling to a different district presents its own risks and dangers... if any of you wish to stay here, I will respect that decision.
Revelations in Fall#010.dst: 當然，前往另一個轄區有它自己的風險與危險……如果你們有人想留下，我尊重那個決定。
Revelations in Fall#010.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#011.src: Ha! And leave you to strategize all on your own? I had foreseen something along these lines, so I have already made arrangements with my work. I will join you, miss.
Revelations in Fall#011.dst: 哈！然後留你一個人去擬定策略？我早就預見到會有這樣的發展，所以我已經跟工作那邊打好招呼了。我跟你去，小姐。
Revelations in Fall#011.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#012.src: An I'm definitely not sitting this one out, are you kidding? I'll follow you wherever you go, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#012.dst: 而我絕對不會缺席這一趟，你在開玩笑嗎？你去哪我就跟到哪，Syndra。
Revelations in Fall#012.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#013.src: I- I'll go too! Wh- what's the point of hav- having magic if I don't use it for our c- c- cause?
Revelations in Fall#013.dst: 我、我也去！如果不把魔法用在我們的事、事業上，那擁有它還有什、什麼意義？
Revelations in Fall#013.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#014.src: Eh. Don't see myself bein' much use out there, to tell you the truth, Synny. And I figure you need someone to hold down the fort while you're gone, anyhow. So I'll stay.
Revelations in Fall#014.dst: 欸。老實說 Synny，我不覺得自己在外頭派得上什麼用場。而且我想你們走了總得有人看家。所以我留下。
Revelations in Fall#014.speaker: Kaio

Revelations in Fall#015.src: That would be appreciated, Kaio. I'll feel more comfortable leaving, knowing the LEaves in the Wind is safe in your care.
Revelations in Fall#015.dst: 那就太好了，Kaio。知道風中之葉交在你手上，我離開會安心得多。
Revelations in Fall#015.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#018.src: You'll... need my medicine. So I'll go...
Revelations in Fall#018.dst: 你們會……需要我的藥。所以我去……
Revelations in Fall#018.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#019.src: Sui... you can stay, if you want. I don't want to force you
Revelations in Fall#019.dst: Sui……你想留下的話可以留下。我不想勉強你
Revelations in Fall#019.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#020.src: N-no! I want to go with you! I just... I need to say goodbye to some people. Before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#020.dst: 不、不用！我想跟你們一起去！我只是……我得先跟一些人道別。在我們出發之前。
Revelations in Fall#020.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#023.src: I'm forver in your debt. Thank you, again, for offering your help.
Revelations in Fall#023.dst: 我永遠欠你這份情。再一次謝謝你願意伸出援手。
Revelations in Fall#023.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#024.src: Sigh... I wish I could disagree. But you're right, I need you to join us.
Revelations in Fall#024.dst: 唉……我真希望我能反駁。但你說得對，我需要你加入我們。
Revelations in Fall#024.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#025.src: I still need to make preparations before we leave namely, arranging passage across the border. I have a contact that I can... hopefully convince to help.
Revelations in Fall#025.dst: 出發前我還得做些準備——具體來說是安排過境。我有一位聯絡人，我……希望能說服他幫忙。
Revelations in Fall#025.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#026.src: You- you can't pos- possibly mean
Revelations in Fall#026.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#027.src: Yes, Zeph, I do. It will be fine.
Revelations in Fall#027.dst: 是的，Zeph，我就是那個意思。不會有事的。
Revelations in Fall#027.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#028.src: As for the rest of you, you should make your own preparations. I don't know how long the window of opportunity will be, so make the most of the time left.
Revelations in Fall#028.dst: 至於你們其餘的人，也去做自己的準備吧。我不知道這個機會的窗口有多長，所以好好把握剩下的時間。
Revelations in Fall#028.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#029.src: Hmn... Zeph, why the concern? We all know miss Syndra knows what she's doing! If she claims to have the situation covered, then I see no reason to doubt her!
Revelations in Fall#029.dst: 唔……Zeph，你在擔心什麼？我們都知道 Syndra 小姐清楚自己在做什麼！既然她說情況在掌握之中，我看不出有什麼理由懷疑她！
Revelations in Fall#029.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#031.src: Ah, no matter! Come now, other children... and {u} of course! Let us all take some time to say our goodbyes. We don't know when we'll be back, after all!
Revelations in Fall#031.dst: 啊，無妨！來吧，其他孩子們……當然還有 {u}！我們都花點時間去道個別。畢竟誰也不知道我們什麼時候回得來！
Revelations in Fall#031.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#032.src: If we'll be back at all...
Revelations in Fall#032.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#033.src: Sui... we will be back. I'll make sure of it! And you know I always keep my word for matters such as these.
Revelations in Fall#033.dst: Sui……我們會回來的。我會確保這一點！而你知道，這種事我向來說到做到。
Revelations in Fall#033.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#034.src: We'll be fine, Sui. We always are.
Revelations in Fall#034.dst: 我們不會有事的，Sui。我們一向如此。
Revelations in Fall#034.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#036.src: Talk with Zeph outside the base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#038.src: I don't know if I- I'm ready for this.
Revelations in Fall#038.dst: 我不知道我準、準備好了沒有。
Revelations in Fall#038.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#039.src: But I have to be! I... I have to.
Revelations in Fall#039.dst: 但我必須準備好！我……我必須。
Revelations in Fall#039.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#041.src: So... I r- really don't trust the Sovereign, and I- I- I'm afraid he might do s- so- something to Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#041.dst: 是這樣的……我真的不信任那位統領，而、而、而我怕他會對 Syndra 做出什、什麼事。
Revelations in Fall#041.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#042.src: It- it's silly, but... if y- you and I can fi- find a way over the wall without having to ask him d- directly, we could avoid a- a potential con- conflict.
Revelations in Fall#042.dst: 這、這很傻，可是……如果你、你和我能找到翻過牆的方法，不必直、直接去求他，我們就能避開一、一場可能的衝、衝突。
Revelations in Fall#042.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#043.src: And besides, it's not like I have a- any- anything better to do...
Revelations in Fall#043.dst: 何況，反正我也沒、沒有什麼更好的事可做……
Revelations in Fall#043.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#044.src: So! L- let's head into town, and s- s- see if we can
Revelations in Fall#044.dst: 所以！我、我們進城去，看、看、看能不能
Revelations in Fall#044.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#045.src: Um... excuse me, s-sorry to interrupt I overheard you were... going into town?
Revelations in Fall#045.dst: 嗯……不好意思，抱、抱歉打斷你們——我聽到你們說要……進城？
Revelations in Fall#045.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#046.src: Sui! Y- yeah, we were pl- planning on it.
Revelations in Fall#046.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#047.src: If... if it wouldn't be too much trouble... could I maybe go with you? I, ah... have some people I want to... say goodbye to.
Revelations in Fall#047.dst: 如果……如果不會太麻煩的話……我可以跟你們一起去嗎？我，啊……有些人我想去……道別。
Revelations in Fall#047.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#048.src: Oh... the people at the R- Re- the Red Fox?
Revelations in Fall#048.dst: 喔……是 R、R——紅狐那邊的人嗎？
Revelations in Fall#048.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#049.src: It's... a restaurant I, um, frequent. The owners are... nice. I wanted to thank them, for, ha, everything.
Revelations in Fall#049.dst: 那是……我，嗯，常去的一家餐館。老闆人……很好。我想謝謝他們，哈，謝謝他們的一切。
Revelations in Fall#049.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#050.src: It's built atop one of th- the tallest tr- trees in {p}, too... so it'll w- wo- work for my idea too. It's jus- just outside {p}'s gates.
Revelations in Fall#050.dst: 那家店蓋在 {p} 最高的幾棵樹之、之一上面……所以也剛好合我的計、計畫。它就在 {p} 的門外。
Revelations in Fall#050.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#051.src: Head to the Red Fox treetop café at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#052.src: L- let's all meet up at the Re- Red Fox café. It's just ou- out- outside the {p} Gates.
Revelations in Fall#052.dst: 我、我們就在紅——紅狐咖啡館會合。它就在 {p} 大門外、外、外面。
Revelations in Fall#052.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#054.src: So, wh- what do you think? It's a n- nice view from up here, is- isn't it?
Revelations in Fall#054.dst: 所以，你覺、覺得如何？從這上面看出去的景色很不、不錯吧？
Revelations in Fall#054.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#055.src: I... bring the others here quite often. They, um, serve the best food in {p}...
Revelations in Fall#055.dst: 我……常帶其他人來這裡。他們，嗯，做的是 {p} 最好吃的東西……
Revelations in Fall#055.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#056.src: Yeah... I'll m- mi- miss our late-night snack runs. Heh.
Revelations in Fall#056.dst: 對啊……我會想、想念我們的宵夜跑。呵。
Revelations in Fall#056.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#058.src: S- Sui, do you... want us t- to stay? We can
Revelations in Fall#058.dst: S、Sui，你……想要我們留、留下來嗎？我們可以
Revelations in Fall#058.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#059.src: N-no! No, no, it's... fine. I'll go find Chen on my own. You two, um, hand something you were going to do, right?
Revelations in Fall#059.dst: 不、不用！不用，沒關係……我沒事。我自己去找 Chen 就好。你們兩個，嗯，本來就有事情要做吧？
Revelations in Fall#059.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#060.src: We did... uh, if y- you're sure, Sui. We'll see you l- la- later?
Revelations in Fall#060.dst: 是有……呃，如、如果你確定的話，Sui。我們待、待會兒見？
Revelations in Fall#060.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#061.src: Y... yes. Um, good... good luck!
Revelations in Fall#061.dst: 嗯……好。那個，祝……祝你們順利！
Revelations in Fall#061.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#062.src: ...okay. Well, {u}, the re- reason we came here... from up h- he- from up here, we have good access to the r- roof- rooftops.
Revelations in Fall#062.dst: ……好。那麼，{u}，我們來這裡的原、原因是……從這上、上、從這上面，我們可以很方便地上到屋、屋頂。
Revelations in Fall#062.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#063.src: I w- w- I want to see if we can ge- get over the wall. If we st- stick to the roofs, we should be able to av- avoid suspicion...
Revelations in Fall#063.dst: 我想——我、我想看看我們能不能翻、翻過那道牆。只要我們沿著屋頂走，應該就能避、避開懷疑……
Revelations in Fall#063.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#065.src: Follow Zeph to the tree branch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#066.src: Ah, Sui! What a pleasure to see you as always!
Revelations in Fall#066.dst: 啊，Sui！一如既往，見到你真開心！
Revelations in Fall#066.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#067.src: Hi, Chen... is, um, business going well?
Revelations in Fall#067.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#068.src: Hum, as well as one can hope, I would say! The Festival does always bring a rush of customers. So, should I prepare the usual for you?
Revelations in Fall#068.dst: 唔，我會說跟人所能期望的一樣好！慶典總是會帶來一波客人。那麼，要我幫你準備老樣子嗎？
Revelations in Fall#068.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#069.src: Oh. Um... that's very kind of you, but, no, not today. Thank you.
Revelations in Fall#069.dst: 喔。嗯……你人真好，不過今天不用了。謝謝你。
Revelations in Fall#069.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#070.src: Very well, very well. Well, since you're here, might I ask if you've had a thought about my job offer?
Revelations in Fall#070.dst: 好的，好的。那麼，既然你來了，我可以問問你考慮過我那份工作邀約了嗎？
Revelations in Fall#070.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#071.src: You basically know our menu inside and out by this point, so I do truly think you'd be a great fit.
Revelations in Fall#071.dst: 你到現在對我們的菜單大概已經瞭若指掌了，所以我是真心覺得你會很適合。
Revelations in Fall#071.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#073.src: Okay, so... just f- fo- follow the green trails!
Revelations in Fall#073.dst: 好，那麼……跟著綠、綠色的路線走就對了！
Revelations in Fall#073.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#074.src: If you g- get lost, meet me back here.
Revelations in Fall#074.dst: 如果你迷、迷路了，就回這裡找我。
Revelations in Fall#074.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#075.src: Travel across the roof tops of {p} starting from .
Revelations in Fall#075.dst: 從 出發，穿越 {p} 的屋頂。

Revelations in Fall#077.src: Do you, uh, w- want to take a break?
Revelations in Fall#077.dst: 你要不、要不要休息一下？
Revelations in Fall#077.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#078.src: Alright, g- good luck! Just re- remember to follow the green trail.
Revelations in Fall#078.dst: 好，祝、祝你順利！記得跟著綠色的路線走就好。
Revelations in Fall#078.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#079.src: I- I'll follow you soon, I'm just w- war- warming up a bit first.
Revelations in Fall#079.dst: 我、我等一下就跟上，我只是先熱、熱、熱個身。
Revelations in Fall#079.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#081.src: Just re- return here when you're ready to st- start again.
Revelations in Fall#081.dst: 你準備好要重、重新開始的時候再回這裡。
Revelations in Fall#081.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#082.src: Ha, I- I guess you got here b- be- before me this time!
Revelations in Fall#082.dst: 哈，這、這一次我看是你比我先、先到了！
Revelations in Fall#082.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#085.src: Aah! I... I... th- that was... c- cl- close.
Revelations in Fall#085.dst: 啊啊！我……我……剛、剛剛那……好、好、好險。
Revelations in Fall#085.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#086.src: That was... th- that was m- magic, wasn't it...? It was l- li- it was like my whole body was... w- was en- engulfed by a, a g- ge- gentle breeze...
Revelations in Fall#086.dst: 那是……那是魔、魔法，對吧……？那感覺就像——就、就像我整個身體被一陣、一陣溫、溫柔的風包住了……
Revelations in Fall#086.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#087.src: I... ha. Th- that was- e- e- exhilarating, but... b- but... Th- there- there's no way we c- ca- we can get across these r- ro- rooftops... one c- cl- one close call is enough f- for me.
Revelations in Fall#087.dst: 我……哈。那、那真是——刺、刺、刺激，可是……可、可是……我們不、不、不可能靠這些屋、屋、屋頂過去……一次驚、驚險對我來說已、已經夠了。
Revelations in Fall#087.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#088.src: Ugh... l- let's just... get back to the R- Red Fox...
Revelations in Fall#088.dst: 唉……我、我們還是……回紅、紅狐去吧……
Revelations in Fall#088.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#089.src: Return to The Red Fox and talk to Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#090.src: I just... I- I- I don't like it. I don't like that S- Syn- Syndra's putting herself in- in danger like that!
Revelations in Fall#090.dst: 我只是……我、我、我不喜歡這樣。我不喜歡 S、Syn——Syndra 這樣把自己置於危、危險之中！
Revelations in Fall#090.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#091.src: I... I owe her a lot. If it weren't for her, I- I- I'd still be st- stuck on the... the st- str- streets. It's thanks to her that I'm still... here.
Revelations in Fall#091.dst: 我……我欠她很多。要不是她，我、我、我到現在還困在……在街、街頭上。是多虧了她，我才還在……這裡。
Revelations in Fall#091.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#092.src: Yeah... I, uh, grew up in a- a small village. S- someone was accused of being c- cursed, and... my people refused to h- ha- hand them over without a- a- wi- without a fight.
Revelations in Fall#092.dst: 對啊……我，呃，是在一、一個小村子長大的。有、有人被指控受了詛咒，然後……我的族人拒絕在沒、沒有——在沒有一戰的情況下把人交出去。
Revelations in Fall#092.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#093.src: ...actually, wh- where is she? I th- thought she'd wait for us before...
Revelations in Fall#093.dst: ……說起來，她人呢？我還、還以為她會等我們一起……
Revelations in Fall#093.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#094.src: Ah, Zeph, is that you I hear?
Revelations in Fall#094.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#095.src: Oh, h- hey Chen. I need to get going, but have you seen Sui? We were g- go- going to meet up here.
Revelations in Fall#095.dst: 喔，嗨 Chen。我得走了，不過你有看到 Sui 嗎？我們本來要、要在這裡會合的。
Revelations in Fall#095.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#096.src: Yes, Sui... she left not long ago. The poor girl, clearly something is weighing on her...
Revelations in Fall#096.dst: 有的，Sui……她不久前離開了。那可憐的孩子，顯然有什麼事壓在她心上……
Revelations in Fall#096.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#097.src: I believe she would have gone to the pond to the southeast... that is where she usually goes when she needs some air.
Revelations in Fall#097.dst: 我想她應該是去東南邊的池塘了……她需要透透氣的時候通常都去那裡。
Revelations in Fall#097.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#098.src: Oh, I s- see. Th- thank you for the help!
Revelations in Fall#098.dst: 喔，我明、明白了。謝、謝謝你幫忙！
Revelations in Fall#098.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#099.src: Of course, anything for you children. Stop by again soon, would you? I'll make you all the family platter, on the house.
Revelations in Fall#099.dst: 不客氣，為你們這些孩子做什麼都行。要再來啊，好嗎？我請你們吃全家拼盤，算我的。
Revelations in Fall#099.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#100.src: I... y- yeah, we... we will! Thanks for the off- offer.
Revelations in Fall#100.dst: 我……好、好，我們……我們會的！謝謝你的邀、邀請。
Revelations in Fall#100.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#102.src: {u}, can I ask you a f- fa- favour?
Revelations in Fall#102.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#103.src: Could you ch- check on Sui for me, p- please? I... I don't know h- how to help her, right now...
Revelations in Fall#103.dst: 可以請你替我去看、看看 Sui 嗎？我……我現在不知道該怎、怎麼幫她……
Revelations in Fall#103.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#104.src: S- some- something's on her mind, but... b- but she won't tell me about it. I've tr- tried asking, but...
Revelations in Fall#104.dst: 她心裡有、有什麼事，可、可是她不肯跟我說。我試、試過問了，但是……
Revelations in Fall#104.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#105.src: ...but if you ask, ma- maybe she'll tell you? I- I don't know. It's worth a try, at- at least, r- r- right?
Revelations in Fall#105.dst: ……但如果是你問，也、也許她會告訴你？我、我不知道。至、至少值得試一試，對、對、對吧？
Revelations in Fall#105.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#106.src: Th- thanks, {u}. Chen said she w- was at the pond to the southeast.
Revelations in Fall#106.dst: 謝、謝了，{u}。Chen 說她在東南邊的池塘。
Revelations in Fall#106.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#107.src: Meet up with Sui near the pond at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#109.src: O-oh, {u}! I didn't... um, expect to see you here.
Revelations in Fall#109.dst: 喔——喔，{u}！我沒有……嗯，沒想到會在這裡看到你。
Revelations in Fall#109.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#110.src: Oh... right. I just... needed some air. It's, hah, kind of a lot. L-leaving Auburn, I mean! I've never... known anywhere else.
Revelations in Fall#110.dst: 喔……對。我只是……需要透透氣。這，哈，資訊量有點大。我是說，要離、離開 Auburn。我從來……沒有認識過別的地方。
Revelations in Fall#110.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#112.src: Can I... tell you something? I was... I wanted to talk to you, earlier, but, um, I... I couldn't build up the courage.
Revelations in Fall#112.dst: 我可以……跟你說件事嗎？我……我稍早就想跟你說了，可是，嗯，我……我沒能鼓起勇氣。
Revelations in Fall#112.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#114.src: S-sorry, I should just... go for it. It- it might be easier if I just, show you, hah...
Revelations in Fall#114.dst: 抱、抱歉，我應該就……直接說。這樣、這樣可能還比較容易，我直接做給你看，哈……
Revelations in Fall#114.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#115.src: You're the first, um, cursed one I've ever... seen. And- and everyone being so kind, about, all of it...
Revelations in Fall#115.dst: 你是我見過的第一個，嗯，受詛者。而——而大家對這一切都那麼寬容……
Revelations in Fall#115.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#116.src: And, I thought, maybe... maybe you could... help. Me. W-with figuring it all out.
Revelations in Fall#116.dst: 所以我想，也許……也許你可以……幫我。幫我把這一切弄明白。
Revelations in Fall#116.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#118.src: But... I don't use, um, a focus. To... to control water. S-so, that means I'm, one of the... d-dangerous ones. That's... th-that's what Mora said, um, earlier.
Revelations in Fall#118.dst: 可是……我不用，嗯，媒介。就能……控制水。所、所以那代表我是，那種……危、危險的。那……那是 Mora，嗯，稍早說的。
Revelations in Fall#118.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#122.src: Oh... g-good. That's- that's good. I'm glad.
Revelations in Fall#122.dst: 喔……太、太好了。那就好。我很高興。
Revelations in Fall#122.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#123.src: Oh... that's, ha, a big thing for someone. B-breaking into a province? I can't imagine, um, doing something like that...
Revelations in Fall#123.dst: 喔……那，哈，對一個人來說是很大的事。闖、闖進一個行省？我無法想像，嗯，做那種事……
Revelations in Fall#123.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#125.src: I'm just... scared. I'm scared that- that if I try to use it, then, I'll h-hurt someone...
Revelations in Fall#125.dst: 我只是……害怕。我怕——我怕如果我試著用它，我就會傷、傷到別人……
Revelations in Fall#125.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#126.src: I'm... not very brave, haha. I didn't, really, join the resistance because... because I wanted to stand up against the crown!
Revelations in Fall#126.dst: 我……不是很勇敢，哈哈。我加入反抗軍，其實不是因為……因為我想站出來對抗王室！
Revelations in Fall#126.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#127.src: Something like that, it feels... impossible.
Revelations in Fall#127.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#128.src: ... I'm only here because I followed Mora. He's the brave one! N-not- not me. I just, ha, had nowhere else to go.
Revelations in Fall#128.dst: ……我在這裡只是因為我跟著 Mora。勇敢的是他！不、不是我。我只是，哈，沒有別的地方可去。
Revelations in Fall#128.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#129.src: And- and everyone else is so, excited about m-ma-magic! Even, um, Mora. And here I am, too afraid to- to even try!
Revelations in Fall#129.dst: 而——而其他人都對魔、魔、魔法那麼興奮！連，嗯，Mora 都是。而我在這裡，連、連試都不敢試！
Revelations in Fall#129.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#131.src: Yeah, but... it- it wouldn't feel, um, right. If the rest of my family is going, then, ha, how could I not go with them?
Revelations in Fall#131.dst: 是啊，可是……那感覺，嗯，不對。如果我其他的家人都要去，那，哈，我怎麼能不跟他們一起去呢？
Revelations in Fall#131.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#132.src: WHat if... something happened to them to you and, and, and- and I wasn't, there? I'd... I'd never f-forgive myself!
Revelations in Fall#132.dst: 萬一……萬一他們——或是你——出了什麼事，而、而、而我不在那裡怎麼辦？我……我永遠不會原、原諒自己！
Revelations in Fall#132.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#133.src: So... s-so, even if I'm scared... I can't stay behind.
Revelations in Fall#133.dst: 所以……所、所以就算我害怕……我也不能留下。
Revelations in Fall#133.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#134.src: ...I'm, um, not much of a fighter. But I'm still good with m-medicine, and healing. So... I can help.
Revelations in Fall#134.dst: ……我，嗯，不太會打架。可是我還是很懂藥、藥和治療。所以……我幫得上忙。
Revelations in Fall#134.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#135.src: Let's... get back home. I should tell Zeph I'm alright.
Revelations in Fall#135.dst: 我們……回家吧。我該跟 Zeph 說我沒事了。
Revelations in Fall#135.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#136.src: Return to the Leaves in the Wind at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#137.src: Thank you for listening to me.
Revelations in Fall#137.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#138.src: I... I want to help. I'm just... scared.
Revelations in Fall#138.dst: 我……我想幫上忙。我只是……害怕。
Revelations in Fall#138.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#139.src: Hrm... ah, {u}, just the leaf I was looking to find!
Revelations in Fall#139.dst: 唔……啊，{u}，正是我要找的那片葉子！
Revelations in Fall#139.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#140.src: I am nearly finished with preparations for our expedition. Supplies packed, goodbyes said, and so on and so forth.
Revelations in Fall#140.dst: 我這趟遠行的準備幾乎都完成了。物資打包好、道別也說了，諸如此類。
Revelations in Fall#140.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#141.src: There is... one last thing, however. If I may ask you for a favor?
Revelations in Fall#141.dst: 不過……還有最後一件事。可否容我請你幫個忙？
Revelations in Fall#141.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#142.src: Excellent! I thank you for your time.
Revelations in Fall#142.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#143.src: ...ah, a busy day, I take it? I promise it will be quick, if you would hear me out.
Revelations in Fall#143.dst: ……啊，看來今天很忙？我保證很快，只要你願意聽我說完。
Revelations in Fall#143.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#144.src: I had mentioned previously, your words on magic had resonated with me! I have been taking some time to practice, with the aid of cursory knowledge of military blessings.
Revelations in Fall#144.dst: 我先前提過，你關於魔法的那番話對我很有共鳴！我一直抽空在練習，並借助我對軍中祝福的粗淺認識。
Revelations in Fall#144.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#145.src: But such training will do me little good in a true combat scenario. So, in the interest of improvement, I would ask for a sparring match against you!
Revelations in Fall#145.dst: 但那樣的訓練在真正的戰鬥情境裡幫不了我多少。所以，為了精進，我想向你請求一場對練！
Revelations in Fall#145.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#146.src: It will help me to spot and shore up my weaknesses. Perhaps it will do the same for you!
Revelations in Fall#146.dst: 那能幫我找出並補強自己的弱點。或許對你也有同樣的作用！
Revelations in Fall#146.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#147.src: Come, follow me to our sparring arena!
Revelations in Fall#147.dst: 來，跟我到我們的對練場去！
Revelations in Fall#147.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#150.src: Oof... you are very talented, I must say!
Revelations in Fall#150.dst: 唔……我必須說，你非常有天分！
Revelations in Fall#150.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#151.src: No wonder miss Syndra is so invested in you, having battled you herself!
Revelations in Fall#151.dst: 難怪 Syndra 小姐這麼看重你，她自己也跟你交過手！
Revelations in Fall#151.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#152.src: Now, tell me, how did I perform?
Revelations in Fall#152.dst: 那麼，告訴我，我表現得如何？
Revelations in Fall#152.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#153.src: Really! In the moment, it did not feel like I stood much of a chance, but I suppose I am still learning to wield it!
Revelations in Fall#153.dst: 真的！當下我並不覺得自己有多少勝算，不過我想我還在學習如何駕馭它！
Revelations in Fall#153.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#154.src: It is odd, though. I have only learned of it recently, yet it fels as though the magic has been with me all along! It is like... muscle memory, I suppose? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#154.dst: 不過這很奇怪。我明明最近才知道有這回事，卻感覺這份魔法一直都跟著我！那就像……肌肉記憶，我想？值得好好想想。
Revelations in Fall#154.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#155.src: Ha! No need to sugarcoat it. I have always specialized in heavy attacks, so I struggle against swift opponents. Rarely have I managed to best Zeph in a spar!
Revelations in Fall#155.dst: 哈！不必客氣。我一向專精於重擊，所以我對付不了身法迅捷的對手。跟 Zeph 對練我幾乎沒贏過！
Revelations in Fall#155.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#156.src: Perhaps therein lies the value of this magic... finding methods to raise area of effect, or slow targets down? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#156.dst: 或許這正是這份魔法的價值所在……找出擴大範圍、或是減緩對手的方法？值得好好想想。
Revelations in Fall#156.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#157.src: An excellent question, though I have no true answers. Perhaps some of what I had learned from military sources has stuck with me?
Revelations in Fall#157.dst: 好問題，儘管我沒有真正的答案。也許是我從軍方管道學來的一些東西留了下來？
Revelations in Fall#157.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#158.src: I do trust it will come to Zeph with time. He is persistent! That trait will serve him well for these purposes.
Revelations in Fall#158.dst: 我相信 Zeph 假以時日也會掌握的。他很有毅力！那份特質在這方面會很有幫助。
Revelations in Fall#158.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#159.src: Hey, Mora! Have you seen oh, there you are. I've been looking for you.
Revelations in Fall#159.dst: 嘿，Mora！你有沒有看到——喔，你在這裡。我一直在找你。
Revelations in Fall#159.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#160.src: Alright, {u}, come with me. We are SORTING through our problems before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#160.dst: 好了，{u}，跟我來。我們在出發之前要把我們的問題「理清楚」。
Revelations in Fall#160.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#161.src: Come on, come on! To the giant tree stump, I don't have all day!
Revelations in Fall#161.dst: 快點，快點！去那個巨大的樹樁，我可沒一整天的時間！
Revelations in Fall#161.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#162.src: ... Ah. Oh dear. She appears to be in a mood today! I suppose that would make sense, given...
Revelations in Fall#162.dst: ……啊。糟糕。她今天看來心情不太好！不過想想也合理，畢竟……
Revelations in Fall#162.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#163.src: Hmm, how should I put it...? Ah, nevermind. You'd best follow her to the tree, see what she wants.
Revelations in Fall#163.dst: 唔，我該怎麼說呢……？啊，算了。你最好跟她去那棵樹，看看她想做什麼。
Revelations in Fall#163.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#164.src: Keep an eye on her for me, would you? Make sure she gets home safely.
Revelations in Fall#164.dst: 替我看著她一點，好嗎？確保她能平安回家。
Revelations in Fall#164.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#165.src: Find Rex at the old tree stump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#166.src: Keep an eye on Rex, would you? I haven't seen her this worked up in a while...
Revelations in Fall#166.dst: 替我看著 Rex 一點，好嗎？我有一陣子沒看她這麼激動了……
Revelations in Fall#166.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#167.src: Good, you came. Took you long enough!
Revelations in Fall#167.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#168.src: So, here's the deal! You are a problem.
Revelations in Fall#168.dst: 所以，情況是這樣！你是個問題。
Revelations in Fall#168.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#169.src: Sure, you've proven yourself a hundred times over! Over and over and over again, you've shown you're on our side.
Revelations in Fall#169.dst: 當然，你已經證明過自己一百次了！一次又一次又一次，你都表現出你站在我們這邊。
Revelations in Fall#169.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#170.src: And that's great! That's great and all! But. But but but but but! You're still. From. Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#170.dst: 那很好！那真的很好！可是。可是可是可是可是！你還是。來自。Wynn。
Revelations in Fall#170.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#171.src: Or... originally from Fruma, whatever. That's actually the problem! If you were just from Wynn, maybe it wouldn't be so bad!
Revelations in Fall#171.dst: 或者說……原本來自 Fruma，隨便啦。那其實才是問題！如果你只是從 Wynn 來的，也許還沒那麼糟！
Revelations in Fall#171.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#172.src: There's oh so many people from Fruma who were shipped off to Wynn! They really like sending off the problem children whenever they can't deal with them anymore.
Revelations in Fall#172.dst: 有那麼多從 Fruma 被送去 Wynn 的人！他們只要應付不了那些麻煩的孩子，就特別喜歡把人打包送走。
Revelations in Fall#172.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#173.src: So I get it! I do! It makes sense! But still... still, why, why... why does it get to be YOU here, and not not...!
Revelations in Fall#173.dst: 所以我懂！我真的懂！那說得通！可是還是……還是，為什麼，為什麼……為什麼在這裡的偏偏是「你」，而不是——不是……！
Revelations in Fall#173.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#176.src: Oh, don't look at me like that.
Revelations in Fall#176.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#177.src: So I had a brother, right? And sure, he was an idiot sometimes, but but he was the only one there who really understood me.
Revelations in Fall#177.dst: 我以前有個哥哥，好嗎？他有時候確實是個白痴，可是——可是他是那裡唯一真正懂我的人。
Revelations in Fall#177.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#178.src: He's the one who carved my bow for me. He heard I was interested in archery, so he... when everyone else told me to just focus on schoolwork, he helped me learn.
Revelations in Fall#178.dst: 我的弓是他替我削的。他聽說我對射箭有興趣，所以他就——在其他人都叫我專心念書的時候，他幫我學。
Revelations in Fall#178.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#179.src: He really hated all the rules we had up there. So he liked to break them. A lot. And eventually, the crown got sick of it. Packed him up, sent him to the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#179.dst: 他非常討厭上面那些規矩。所以他喜歡去打破它們。打破很多。最後王室受夠了。把他打包，送去 Roughworks。
Revelations in Fall#179.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#180.src: The worst part was, our parents agreed to it! Said it'd be good for him, to get some real hard work!
Revelations in Fall#180.dst: 最糟的是，我們的爸媽同意了！說那對他有好處，去吃點真正的苦！
Revelations in Fall#180.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#181.src: I never liked it there anyway. It took me a while to build up the courage, but eventually I stole some of our money and bought a ticket to take me there.
Revelations in Fall#181.dst: 反正我本來就不喜歡那裡。我花了一段時間才鼓起勇氣，但我最後偷了我們家一些錢，買了一張去那裡的票。
Revelations in Fall#181.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#182.src: I didn't pack a whole lot. I guess I expected to find him and live with him! Stupid. Should've thought ahead more.
Revelations in Fall#182.dst: 我沒帶多少東西。我想我當時是以為我會找到他、跟他一起住吧！蠢斃了。應該多想想的。
Revelations in Fall#182.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#183.src: He wasn't there, obviously. Heard from some of his friends that he kept being stupid over there. Got caught by the crown, and they decided to stop giving him second chances.
Revelations in Fall#183.dst: 他當然不在那裡。從他幾個朋友那裡聽說，他在那邊還是繼續犯蠢。被王室抓到，然後他們決定不再給他第二次機會。
Revelations in Fall#183.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#184.src: So, he's gone! He promised he'd see me again someday, and and of course he didn't follow through. I guess I wasn't important enough to remember.
Revelations in Fall#184.dst: 所以，他不在了！他答應過總有一天會再見到我，然後——然後他當然沒做到。我想是我不夠重要，值不得他記住。
Revelations in Fall#184.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#185.src: Yes, I know. I just... I guess I just hoped I'd be an exception.
Revelations in Fall#185.dst: 是啊，我知道。我只是……我想我只是希望自己是個例外。
Revelations in Fall#185.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#187.src: I haven't been very fair to you, have I? It's not your fault you're here and he isn't.
Revelations in Fall#187.dst: 我對你一直不太公平，對吧？你在這裡而他不在，這不是你的錯。
Revelations in Fall#187.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#189.src: So... sorry. For all of that.
Revelations in Fall#189.dst: 所以……對不起。為剛才那一切。
Revelations in Fall#189.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#191.src: Give me some time, would you? I need to... I don't know. I just need some space.
Revelations in Fall#191.dst: 給我一點時間，好嗎？我需要……我不知道。我就是需要一點空間。
Revelations in Fall#191.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#193.src: Okay. I... won't take too long. Nobody ever comes here, anyway.
